definition: to have something in your hands or grip
description: A hamster stands on a sunlit wooden kitchen counter with a chocolate-coated ice cream bar in each paw. It keeps the two bars up in front of its face, hiding everything but its ears and whiskers, and holds them there while the sun comes through the window behind it. Then it brings them down and holds them up and out to either side, grinning wide at the camera, with a bite taken out of the bar on the right.

de.answer: Er hält zwei Eis am Stiel hoch.
